summary: Practise shelter assessment, accountable distributions, and field reporting in a five-day course. Explore the outline and plan your training.
lede: Relief distribution training helps humanitarian response staff assess shelter needs and organize safe, accountable delivery of essential items. For shelter officers, distribution coordinators, and programme managers, it builds practical skills in KoboToolbox-based assessment, transparent prioritization, site planning, and stock reconciliation. Participants practise using the Sphere Handbook and Core Humanitarian Standard to guide distribution planning, feedback tracking, and operational reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate emergency shelter, essential-item distributions, field assessments, and accountability processes. It suits practitioners who need to connect response standards with decisions made in constrained field operations.
audience: Camp Coordination and Camp Management Officers
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: prior experience in humanitarian response, emergency shelter, relief distribution, logistics, or field assessment. Bring familiarity with your organization’s response procedures; coding skills are not required. Digital exercises use spreadsheet-based records and KoboToolbox examples, so access to a laptop and a web browser is useful.
